### Kimi K3.1 Pro - Moonshot’s 3T-class model for coding, 3D and finance

Kimi K3.1 Pro is Moonshot’s most capable 3T-class model, a post-trained update to K3 with a 1M-token context. Moonshot reports gains in coding, 3D modeling, finance and agentic tasks, including 65.7% on Terminal-Bench 4.0. A Highspeed version runs 2-3x faster. It’s live on Kimi.ai, the apps, Kimi Code and the API. Moonshot says open weights are due by November 4, 2026.

results.title: Tencent Hy: Tencent's frontier AI model series | Product Hunt
results.content:
On Tencent’s own tests, Hy4 scored 3.04 in a blind financial evaluation (213 professionals, 579 tasks), ahead of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 at 2.97 and Kimi K3.1 Pro and GLM-5.3 at 2.68. It also scored 83.18 on WorkBuddy with a 96.15% pass rate. These are Tencent’s own results, not independent tests.
